perVenue.continental: no page for this venue — a guessed venue ID (476124) resolves to an unrelated Long Center room, and no web search surfaced a genuine ticketmaster.com venue page for Continental Club Austin. Ticketmaster does not appear to sell this venue.
perVenue.kingdom: no page for this venue — web search confirms Kingdom Nightclub (Austin) sells through DICE (dice.fm) and is listed on Resident Advisor (ra.co), not Ticketmaster.
perVenue.summit: no page for this venue — web search found only third-party aggregators (RA.co, Vivid Seats, Ticket Fairy) for Summit Rooftop Lounge; no ticketmaster.com venue page located.
perVenue.vulcan: no page for this venue — web search found Vulcan Gas Company selling through its own site (vulcanatx.com / Vulcan Presents via ticketsauce.com), plus aggregators (Bandsintown, Songkick, JamBase); no ticketmaster.com venue page located.

coverage.why: Ticketmaster server-renders only the first 20 events on any venue page and hides the rest behind a client-side 'More Events' button (a POST-authenticated infinite-scroll call this courtesy study did not reproduce) — so any venue listing more than 20 upcoming shows (Moody Center, Moody Amphitheater, ACL Live, 3TEN, Stubb's Waller Creek, Scoot Inn, Emo's, Antone's) is READ ONLY THROUGH ITS FIRST 20, ordered by date, and this file says exactly where each one stopped rather than pretending completeness. Venues with 20 or fewer total listed events (Germania, Stubb's Indoors, Mohawk, Brushy Street Commons, The Concourse Project) are fully captured. Four of our 17 venues (Continental Club, Kingdom, Summit, Vulcan Gas Company) have no Ticketmaster presence at all — independently confirmed venues, not a scraping failure. Empire Control Room has a live TM page that currently lists zero upcoming events. The Parish has no live TM venue page: its old TM venue ID was reassigned to an unrelated Canadian comedy club, and the physical address now resolves under 'Brushy Street Commons' — flagging this venue-identity question rather than resolving it unilaterally, since our app's venue list treats 'parish' and 'brushy' as two separate venues.

cityWide.note: Not counted. Ticketmaster's Austin-wide discover page covers every category (sports, theater, comedy, family) across the whole metro, not just our 17 venues, and is paginated/lazy-loaded the same way single-venue pages are — getting an accurate 'next 30 days at our venues' count from it would mean re-deriving exactly the per-venue work already done above, filtered down. The per-venue events[] array in this file is the trustworthy count for our footprint; a city-wide total would double up effort without adding signal.

linkBehavior: Every event's own TM page ('url') and its buy button both point straight at ticketmaster.com — no affiliate tag, no redirect hop observed (e.g. https://www.ticketmaster.com/jungle-world-tour-2026-austin-texas-09-24-2026/event/3A006471B677B085). A minority of listings say 'On partner site' and route through a DIFFERENT ticketer entirely while still being indexed on the TM venue page: Stubb's Indoors' recurring Gospel Brunch series goes straight to the venue's own site (https://stubbsaustin.com/gospel-brunch/, ticketer=venue), Brushy Street Commons' comedy nights route through TicketWeb Canada (https://www.ticketweb.ca/event/..., ticketer=other:ticketweb.ca — the same nights TM's own Levity Comedy Club page in Hamilton, ON lists), and one ACL Live comedy show (Daniel Sloss) routes to AXS (https://www.axs.com/events/1324669/daniel-sloss-tickets). Ticketmaster attraction/event IDs are visible in every event URL's trailing segment (e.g. 3A006471B677B085) and were recorded verbatim in each event's 'url' field rather than a separate id field, since the brief said to note them 'in notes' and every url already carries one.
